---
name: Suggest a layout
about: A stacked shape of tiles to play Awase on, drawn from a traditional shape or one of your own
title: "Layout: "
labels: enhancement
---

**Its name** (and in Japanese, if it has one):

**The shape.** A drawing, or text with one block per layer, bottom layer first, and an `x` where a tile's top left corner goes. A tile is two characters wide and two lines tall, and a tile may sit half a tile over from its neighbour.

**How many tiles.** The number has to be even, since tiles are taken in pairs.

**Its width in tiles.** The width names a layout, so it has to be one no layout has. Widths 4, 8 to 17, 20 and 26 are taken; 5 to 7, 18, 19, 21 to 25, and 27 or more, are free.

**Where the shape comes from:** a traditional shape anyone may draw, or your own. Layouts here are our own drawings of shapes. Please do not send the art or the data of another game.

We will deal and clear it at every level from several seeds before it goes in. The existing layouts never change.
